title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: Walk through a visit from the guest’s perspective. Which menu arrives first? What stays on the table? How is the bill presented? That sequence gives the collection its structure. Design then follows your lighting, tableware and service, with shared materials and different formats for different roles.

title.html: From the menu to the bill

body.html: The menu is opened and passed around; the bill accompanies the final moment. We develop these touchpoints with placemats and coasters as a coordinated collection. Fine genuine Italian leather and high-quality PU offer different routes to your restaurant’s identity, with a broad palette of colours and finishes and the selected model’s material options as the starting point.

A concise tasting menu needs a different presentation from an extensive wine list. We consider page count, how often content changes and how your team handles the covers. The Berlin model, for example, can use exposed or concealed screw-post binding. Materials, dimensions and internal details are selected around your actual content.

Review samples at your tables and under your bar lighting, not just in a studio. Readability, weight and feel all matter. Care and cleaning should be agreed for the chosen surface and your operating routine. An additional bar menu or a second restaurant can be considered in the initial brief.
Desk pads and notepad holders for suites, workspaces and meeting tables. Developed as a coordinated collection of formats, materials and branding.
